metadata.description: it-guy-pro — personal IT guy for non-technical users by xiaolai

plugins.name: it-guy-pro
plugins.description: Personal IT guy for non-technical users — 11 plain-language commands (checkup, cleanup, organize, fix, automate, toolbox, backup, network, open-internet, onboard, profile), 4 specialized agents, observation-first onboarding that asks exactly one question (your name — the IT guy is summoned from any session by typing _it), a machine profile that persists across sessions and retires its own stale beliefs by retesting them, a safety hook that blocks destructive shell commands, a toolbox that turns every repeated chore into a reusable micro-tool and proactively offers automations you didn't know to ask for, evidence-based home-network diagnosis that finds the failing layer before you spend money, and a guide to building your own private internet connection. macOS-first.
